body:
Maintainer request from #1572 and maintainer comment ("This should result in an "import" feature under Model - not "load" feature...").

Depends on #1873, #1874, and #1875.

## Goal
Connect qualified native CAD formats to Model > Import, recent models, and viewport drag-and-drop with Import wording, add a `cadmpeg` path setting, and refuse native CAD files cleanly on `wasm32`.

## Scope
- Update Model UI labels and drop hints to use `"Import"` instead of `"Open"` or `"load"` (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/panes.rs:380`, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/file_drop.rs:22`, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/recent_drop.rs`). Update existing string assertions in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs:2826` and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/structural.rs:569`.
- Feed qualified native extensions from `camcraft-app`'s shared extension table into `mesh_dialog()` (`crates/ui/src/state.rs`), `MESH_EXTENSIONS` (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/file_drop.rs`), and recent-model re-import without creating a second import pipeline.
- Keep `cadmpeg` execution inside the background `begin_import` / `finish_import` worker (`crates/ui/src/state.rs`) so the UI never blocks. Display named status errors when `cadmpeg` is missing, too old, or refuses a broken file.
- Add an optional `cadmpeg` executable path setting in the UI preferences panel backed by `ViewPrefs` (`crates/app/src/prefs.rs`).
- On `cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")`: keep `accept_attr` in `crates/ui/src/browser_files.rs` restricted to `.stl,.obj,.step,.stp`. Return a clear named refusal (`Not available in the browser: importing .<ext> requires the desktop app with cadmpeg. Export to STEP first.`) from `ImportModel::from_bytes` (`crates/app/src/commands/import_model.rs`) and browser file pick/drop paths (`crates/ui/src/browser_files.rs`, `state_picked.rs`, `file_pick.rs`).
- Update UI `file_drop`, `structural`, and browser-refusal tests to verify the new labels, background errors, preference persistence, and `wasm32` guard.

## Done means
Desktop Model > Import and viewport drop use `"Import"` text, load qualified formats through `ImportModel`/`UpdateModel`, expose `cadmpeg_path` in preferences, show named errors, and refuse native CAD files cleanly on `wasm32` (`structural` and `file_drop` UI tests pass).

Part of #1572
